# Machine-readable resolver expectations for fixture-repo, derived from
# EXPECTED.md (the human-readable source; keep both in sync).
#
# Line format (one edge per line):
#
#   [prefix]<kind> <src> -> <dst> [conf>=N]
#
#   <src>/<dst>  path::Symbol, Symbol = container chain joined with "."
#                (e.g. OrderService.PlaceOrder). A bare path (imports,
#                includes) names a file or package directory.
#                external:<name> = target outside the indexed code; the
#                reference must exist and stay unresolved (dst NULL).
#   conf>=N      minimum confidence (100 T1, 90 T2, 80 T3, 50 T4).
#   prefix       none = must exist; "?" = desirable, optional;
#                "!" = must NOT exist.
#
# Sections start with "[<lang>]" (model.Lang names). Each language unit owns
# its section and its resolver test (internal/resolve/<lang>_test.go) reads
# only that section. Kinds "imports"/"includes" are produced by the indexer
# (imports table), not by the resolver; resolver tests skip them.
# Blank lines and lines starting with "#" are ignored.
